content: पाठः [पठ्-भावे घञ्] .²1 Reciting, recitation, repeating. .²2 Reading, perusal, study. .²3 Studying or reciting the Vedas (ब्रह्मयज्ञ), one of the five daily Yajñas or sacrifices to be performed by Brāhmaṇas. .²4 A particular method of reciting the text of the Veda (of which there are five:-- संहिता, पद, क्रम, जटा and घन). .²5 The text of a book, a reading, variant; अत्र गन्धवद् गन्धमादनम् इति आगन्तुकः पाठः . प्राचीनपाठस्तु सुगन्धिर्गन्धमादनः इति पुल्लिङ्गान्तः <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Ku. 6. 46</ls>.
